contea di ritrovamento: North Lincolnshire (Inghilterra e Galles)
D/ CONS[--] ; R/ FEL TEMP REPARATIO]

Copper alloy coin. Nummus of House of Constantine (306-361), possibly Constantius II (323-361), irregular copy of a fallen horseman issue of 355-61, Reece period 18. Obverse description: Bust diademed right, with large eye. Obverse inscription: CONS[--]. Reverse description: [Soldier advancing left] spearing fallen horseman. Reverse inscription: FEL TEMP REPARATIO]. Diameter: 9.2mm, Weight:…
